Name: Vintage Interface - The Love of Cooking v2
Author: ShilohAreles
Description:
[center]﻿[/center][left]To install just extract this mod into your mod folders. All set!
To remove just delete the folder, no issues will occur.

You will need:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4697]Vintage Interface v2[/url]﻿ and Nom0ri's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20754]Vintage Interface v2 1.6 fix[/url]﻿ to cover any missed textures and obviously [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]The Love of Cooking[/url]﻿

There were some icons that I recolored but was unable to find in game just yet, so if you see them and they look wonky, please send me a screenshot/some instructions on how to navigate to those icons so I know how I should fix :)[/left]
